ways.label: SH73 near the Mingha confluence over Taruahuna Pass and down the Otehake to SH73 at Aickens

start.name: SH73, 5 km south of Arthur's Pass village
start.quote: The east-coast end of the track starts beside SH73, 5 km south of Arthur's Pass village, just after the Mingha bluffs.

via.name: Bealey River
via.quote: Cross the Bealey River just above its confluence with the Mingha River

via.name: Edwards River East Branch
via.quote: Cross the east branch of the Edwards River

via.name: Lake Kaurapataka Track
via.quote: Follow the Lake Kaurapataka Track along the south side of the lake.

via.name: Pfeifer Creek
via.quote: Cross Pfeifer Creek to the true left

via.name: 4WD road down the Taramakau valley
via.quote: Follow this road down the Taramakau valley

via.name: Otira River
via.quote: Cross the Otira River (if fordable) over to SH73 at Aickens.

evidence: The east-coast end of the track starts beside SH73, 5 km south of Arthur's Pass village, just after the Mingha bluffs. The west-coast end of the track starts beside SH73 at Aickens, where the Taramakau River meets the Otira River.
Cross the Bealey River just above its confluence with the Mingha River, 5 km south of Arthur’s Pass village.
Cross the Otira River (if fordable) over to SH73 at Aickens.

exits.name: Otira River flood track to the Morrison footbridge
exits.quote: back-track to the flood track that travels up the true right of the river to the Morrison footbridge

side_trips.name: hot sulphur spring
side_trips.quote: a hot sulphur spring in the old riverbed on the far side

side_trips.name: grassy area beside Lake Kaurapataka
side_trips.quote: a short side-track on the right leads to a level grassy area beside the lake

doubts: Start ref F2 (Mingha Track meets West Coast Road) is taken as the SH73 start 5 km south of Arthur's Pass village; the feature is named for the Mingha Track, not this route. Aickens has no road end feature, so T4 (place) is given. Between Taruahuna Pass and the Lake Sally side river, and below the hot springs, the text gives alternative river or track options; only shared places are listed. The page says to cross the Bealey River first and the Otira River 'if fordable'; Otehake itself is not crossed. Whaiti Stream recorded as a plain via (crossing implied, not instructed).
